data.name: Rust Born
data.detailed_description:
welcome to the new adventure!

Rust Born is a neo-noir top-down shooter about losing yourself, survival, and corporations that devour cities. You play as a detective named Gabriel, who by fate finds himself trapped in a strange, distorted city ruled by faceless corporations. This place is an anti-utopia that breathes steel, glass, and memories of a world that no longer exists. The player will face a linear top-down action game with a heavy atmosphere, a deep story, and survival elements. Every shot could be your last. Every shadow — a trap. Every decision — reshapes the world around you.

unique indie top-down shooter

A unique setting and weapons will not let you get bored, in an alternative universe where  science has taken a different direction, corporations rule the world and everything,and you  - are trying to survive!

And the constant tension, interesting plot, and surroundings will not let you get bored!

A unique story that you won't hear anywhere else!

In a world where religion never held back progress and the Second World War ended in a Nazi victory, humanity pushed far beyond the limits of possibility — and paid the price.

The year is 1958, according to the New Calendar.
On the ruins of old empires, technological conglomerates have risen — megacorporations that rule the world without mercy or competition. America, GBC, Vereinigt Stelle — global blocs keep populations in poverty, conduct experiments across entire continents, and reduce human life to the level of a commodity.

But the greatest threat isn't corporate greed.
It’s "The Bloom" — a synthetic living plant, originally designed as a bio-implant, which mutated into a sentient parasite. It grows through human flesh and mind, turning people into living sustenance. The infection spreads. Governments remain silent. Corporations are hiding something.

Gabriel is a former detective who lost everything.
Once, he tried to investigate the first Bloom incident. Now, he scrubs floors in a diner. But a chance awakening in a Chinese shipping container filled with cybernetic humans drags him back into a web of events where humanity teeters between survival — and complete absorption by a new form of life.

ENTER A WORLD WHERE:

  • Bioengineering governs body and mind.

  • Megacorporations decide who lives — and who blooms.

  • The Red Gulf is either the last bastion of freedom… or the cradle of an even greater horror.

  • And your own mind… may no longer be yours.

data.short_description: Rust Born is a neo noir top-down shooter about survival, loss of self, and a city devoured by corporations. You are Detective Gabriel, trapped in a twisted dystopian city where every shot could be your last, and every decision changes the world. Atmosphere, plot, survival.
